Name: Weedsplosion
Author: stardemod
Description:
In the [b]Weedsplosion[/b] mod, weeds, debris, and other obstacles spread every 10 in-game minutes. Trees, twigs, rocks, and grass grow just as fast as the weeds, creating a relentless challenge. Debris now spawns daily across the entire valley, including inside buildings, making survival even more intense.
It’s highly recommended to start a new game and face the challenge of escaping your overgrown farm while trying to maintain control. Can you tame the chaos of weeds, debris, and trees to achieve farming success amidst this explosion of growth?

[b]New Features:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fine-tuned growth rate of debris for a balanced challenge.
[*]Daily valley-wide debris spawns, affecting every area, including buildings.
[*]Dynamic stone spawns in mineshafts. You cannot escape from the debris.
[/list][b]
Customization:[/b]
The mod includes a configuration file that is generated in the mod folder after the first launch. This file allows you to adjust the daily spawn rates for debris, weeds, and other growth and if debri should spawn inside, giving you control over the intensity of the challenge. Tailor the experience to suit your playstyle!
